briefdescription.para: Global array of DSI TX Subsystem sub-core instances.

detaileddescription.para: Each array element contains the driver instances for all sub-cores (DSI, MIPI TX PHY, DPHY) associated with an instance of the DSI TX Subsystem.

briefdescription.para: This function queries the subsystem instance configuration to determine the included sub-cores.

detaileddescription.para: For each sub-core that is present in the design the sub-core driver instance is binded with the subsystem sub-core driver handle

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the Subsystem instance

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the sub-cores were resolved successfully
XST_FAILURE if the base address was not found in the config table (out-of-range index)

briefdescription.para: This function initializes the MIPI DSI TX subsystem and included sub-cores.

detaileddescription.para: This function must be called prior to using the subsystem. Initialization includes setting up the instance data for top level as well as all included sub-core therein, and ensuring the hardware is in a known stable state

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the Subsystem instance to be worked on.
points to the configuration structure associated with the subsystem instance.
is the base address of the device. If address translation is being used, then this parameter must reflect the virtual base address. Otherwise, the physical address should be used.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if initialization is successful
XST_FAILURE if initialization is failure

simplesect.para: Non-zero if escape mode is available, 0 otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Selects the DCS command mode or LPDT transport.

detaileddescription.para: Chooses LPDT or DCS command mode for command packets. Returns XST_NO_FEATURE on designs without escape mode.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XDsiTxSs instance.
XDSI_DCS_CMD_MODE or XDSI_LPDT_MODE.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the transport was selected.
XST_NO_FEATURE if escape-mode logic is not present in hardware.
XST_FAILURE if the controller is not in command mode, or a previous command never completed.

briefdescription.para: Sends a command packet over LPDT.

detaileddescription.para: Sends the command packet held in the subsystem structure over LPDT. Returns XST_NO_FEATURE on designs without escape mode.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XDsiTxSs instance.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the packet was accepted for transmission.
XST_NO_FEATURE if escape-mode logic is not present in hardware.
XST_INVALID_PARAM if a long-packet payload exceeds 251 bytes.
XST_FAILURE on failure in packet transmission.

simplesect.para: The transport must already be selected via XDsiTxSs_SetLpdtMode.

briefdescription.para: Enters or exits the Ultra-Low Power State (ULPS).

detaileddescription.para: Puts the DSI link into ULPS, or brings it back out. Returns XST_NO_FEATURE on designs without escape mode.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XDsiTxSs instance.
1 to enter ULPS, 0 to exit ULPS.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the requested ULPS transition completed.
XST_NO_FEATURE if escape-mode logic is not present in hardware.
XST_FAILURE if ULPS entry or exit was not observed in time.

simplesect.para: ULPS entry resets the controller image FIFOs; the caller must re-arm the video output from a fresh frame after exit.

briefdescription.para: Reports whether the DSI lanes are in ULPS.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XDsiTxSs instance.

simplesect.para: Non-zero if the lanes are in ULPS, 0 otherwise.
